entries.title: Hosea 5:1
segments: ¶Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment [is] toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

words.text: [is] toward you, because ye have been a snare

entries.title: Hosea 5:2
segments: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I [have been] a rebuker of them all. {though: or, and} {a rebuker: Heb. a correction}

words.text: of them all. {though: or, and} {a rebuker: Heb. a correction}

entries.title: Hosea 5:3
segments: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, [and] Israel is defiled.

words.text: from me: for now, O Ephraim

entries.title: Hosea 5:4
segments: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms [is] in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD. {They will...: or, Their doings will not suffer them} {frame: Heb. give}

words.text: of them, and they have not known
. {They will...: or, Their doings will not suffer them} {frame: Heb. give}

entries.title: Hosea 5:5
segments: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.

entries.title: Hosea 5:6
segments: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find [him]; he hath withdrawn himself from them.

entries.title: Hosea 5:7
segments: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.

entries.title: Hosea 5:8
segments: ¶Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, [and] the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud [at] Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.

entries.title: Hosea 5:9
segments: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.

entries.title: Hosea 5:10
segments: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: [therefore] I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

entries.title: Hosea 5:11
segments: Ephraim [is] oppressed [and] broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.

entries.title: Hosea 5:12
segments: Therefore [will] I [be] unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness. {rottenness: or, a worm}

entries.title: Hosea 5:13
segments: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah [saw] his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound. {king Jareb: or, the king of Jareb: or, the king that should plead}

words.text: . {king Jareb: or, the king of Jareb: or, the king that should plead}

entries.title: Hosea 5:14
segments: For I [will be] unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, [even] I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue [him].

entries.title: Hosea 5:15
segments: I will go [and] return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early. {acknowledge...: Heb. be guilty}
